a non-brokered private placement of up to 5.6M Units at C$0.01 each, targeting gross proceeds of up to C$56,000.
Each Unit includes one common share and one warrant, with each warrant exercisable at C$0.06 for two years from issuance.
Net proceeds are intended for working capital and corporate overhead, with no more than 10% of gross proceeds allocated to investor relations activities.
